carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Each bag up to 55 x 40 x 20 cm (22 x 16 x 8 in), wheels and handles included
carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Carry-on page, section I; same figures in General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 6.3.1.

weight_economy.value: 1 bag up to 5 kg (11 lb), Economy and Premium Economy
weight_economy.notes: Carry-on page table ("Super-Economy" there; "premium economy" in General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 6.3.1.)

weight_business_first.value: 2 bags, up to 8 kg (17 lb) each
weight_business_first.notes: Carry-on page table; General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 6.3.1.: "The weight of a single piece ... in first class and business class shall not exceed 8 kg".

personal_item.value: 1 personal item that fits under the seat in front, such as a handbag, briefcase, laptop bag or camera bag; no size is given

piece_weight_economy.value: International: depends on fare brand and route. Most routes, including the USA and Canada: 2 x 23 kg on Latitude, Selected and Flex, 1 x 23 kg on Standard. Europe (IATA zone 2.2, including the UK, Germany and France): 1 x 23 kg on every brand
piece_weight_economy.notes: Free baggage allowance PDF, piece-concept routes, "Effective from July 10, 2026". Flex also drops to 1 piece for Turkey/Georgia and IATA zone 3.2.

piece_weight_premium_economy.value: 2 x 23 kg on Latitude, Selected and Flex; 1 x 23 kg on Standard
piece_weight_premium_economy.notes: Free baggage allowance PDF, piece-concept routes, "Effective from July 10, 2026".

piece_weight_business.value: 2 x 32 kg (First and Business, all brands, routes to and from the Chinese Mainland)
piece_weight_business.notes: Free baggage allowance PDF, piece-concept routes, "Effective from July 10, 2026".

size_weight.value: International: each free bag up to 158 cm (62 in) total and 32 kg; domestic: each free bag up to 100 x 60 x 40 cm
size_weight.notes: Checked baggage page, section II.2 and II.3; international 32 kg also in the CoC and both allowance PDFs.

domestic_allowance.value: Within the Chinese Mainland (weight concept): First 40 kg, Business 30 kg, Premium Economy and Economy 20 kg, infants 10 kg
domestic_allowance.notes: Free baggage allowance PDF, weight-concept domestic routes. Routes to Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan use the piece concept.

conflicting_values: 45 kg per bag on domestic flights (checked baggage page, II.3)
32 kg per bag, no domestic exception (CoC 6.2 and both allowance PDFs)
domestic_max_piece.notes: Air China pages disagree, read 2026-10-05: https://webresource.airchina.com.cn/en-US/content/travel_info/preparing/luggage/check/tyxlgz/ and https://webresource.airchina.com.cn/en-US/content/trans_conditions/dcpb/.

conflicting_values: Some Economy Standard routes include no free checked bag (2024 branded-fares announcement)
Economy Standard gets 1 x 23 kg on every listed route (July 2026 piece-concept allowance PDF)
standard_fare_checked_bag.notes: Air China pages disagree, read 2026-10-05: https://webresource.airchina.com.cn/en-US/content/c/2024-02-09/16521.shtml and https://webresource.airchina.com.cn/airchinacms/upload/materials/file/2026/07/13/dd55e90b1b26891256030da150d46082e38b2f88.pdf.

fare_name.notes: Branded-fares announcement: "four fare options: Economy Standard, Economy Flex, Economy Comfort, and Economy Latitude". The July 2026 allowance PDF calls the third brand "Selected". Whether Standard includes a checked bag is disputed (see baggage).

seat_selection_included.value: Standard seats can be chosen free; paid and mileage seat selection are also offered
seat_selection_included.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 9.4: "you may select standard complimentary seats or opt for paid or mileage-redemption seat selection services".

change_cancellation_policy.value: Not refundable; changes are allowed for a fee
change_cancellation_policy.notes: Branded-fares announcement: "Economy Standard does not allow ticket refunds, and rebooking is subject to a fee."

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Air China publishes fixed cutoffs only for flights departing Beijing; its conditions of carriage say deadlines differ by airport.

domestic_cutoff.notes: Check-in FAQ, Beijing departures. General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 4.2.3. says deadlines vary by airport.

international_cutoff.value: 60 minutes before departure for international and regional flights (departing Beijing)

boarding_close.value: Boarding gates close 10 minutes before departure (flights departing Beijing)
boarding_close.notes: Check-in FAQ. General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 4.3.1.: gate closing times differ by airport.

conflicting_values: Online check-in for all flights ends two hours before departure
Online check-in for all international flights ends three hours before departure
online_checkin.notes: Both sentences appear on the same check-in FAQ page; the page also says opening times differ by flight.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

rebooking_refund.value: For a delay, cancellation or schedule change, one free change (Air China flights first, or another airline), or a refund of the unused fare and taxes with no refund fee
rebooking_refund.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clauses 3.1.3.1, 3.1.3.3, 3.2.3.1 and 8.2.1.

duty_of_care_policy.value: Meals and accommodation are provided when a delay or cancellation at the departure airport is Air China's fault, or at a stopover or diversion; for weather and other causes outside its control, Air China helps arrange them at the passenger's cost
duty_of_care_policy.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 8.2.3.

cash_compensation.value: For delays caused by Air China: RMB 200 per passenger for 4 to 8 hours, RMB 400 for 8 hours or more
cash_compensation.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), clause 8.3.1.

phone_home_market.notes: Air China hotline numbers page, China: "0086-10-95583 | 24 hours a day, seven days a week".

phone_us.value: +1 800 882 8122 (North America; 06:00-21:00 Pacific weekdays, 07:30-16:00 weekends and holidays)
phone_us.notes: Air China hotline numbers page, North America.

email.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), Article 10, complaints.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: General Conditions of Carriage for Passengers and Baggage (revised July 2026, effective 1 Jul 2026), page header.
